# Milvus

> > Milvus is a high-performance, cloud-native distributed vector database built for AI applications, specializing in semantic search, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and hybrid search capabilities.

Milvus powers AI applications through efficient vector similarity search and integrates with popular frameworks like LangChain, Spring Boot, and Dify. Developed by Zilliz, it supports both semantic embeddings and full-text search (BM25) for production-ready AI assistants and agents.

## Key Topics

- Vector Database
- RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
- Semantic Search
- Vector Embeddings
- Hybrid Search
- AI Agents
- Milvus 2.0 / 2.5 / 2.6
- Zilliz
- BM25 Full-Text Search
- Cloud-Native Architecture
- Vector Similarity Search
- LLM Integration
- Production AI Applications
- Multimodal Search
- Distributed Systems
